这是一个非常简单的 ComfyUI 初学者友好的文本到图像工作流程，它将与具有多个 LORA 的单个 Flux GGUF 模型一起使用（此工作流程确实需要 ComfyUI 的 LORA Manager 插件才能运行。最好安装 ComfyUI 管理器和 LORA Manager 插件，以帮助您轻松下载和管理检查点、LORA 和其他资源。这两个不仅对此工作流程有帮助，而且在任何其他情况下都会为您提供很多帮助）。我还包含了所有必需的模型下载脚本（适用于 Windows 和 Linux/Mac），这样您就可以尽快开始创建您的 AI Art，因为这些脚本会为您下载所有必要的核心 SD 1.5、SDXL 1.0、Flux GGUF 和 HiDream GGUF 文件。确保使用 ComfyUI 管理器为 ComfyUI 安装 GGUF 插件，并将正确的文件放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的 SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0 的其他工作流程以及 嗨梦。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需先选择您想要的 Flux GGUF 模型，然后加载

#2.从 LORA Manager 启动一个或多个匹配的 LORA

＃3。然后输入您的提示（Flux 的 GGUF 模型不接受负数，因此将其留空）。

＃4。选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃5。选择图像采样方法、cfg、步骤等设置

＃6。最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

*** 如果您知道如何正确禁用 LORA 节点，此工作流程也将起作用

并绕过它

享受吧！

（更新 - V2.0 进行了新的调整，现在保存带有时间戳的输出图像，更容易遵循，生成更好的输出，我还使用 Flux Krea GGUF 检查了这个版本，除了旧的下载脚本文件之外，我还在新的工作流程存档文件中包含了一个文本文件，其中包含指向所有新模型的下载链接，如 WAN 2.2、Flux Krea、HiDream E 等我一直在使用的未包含在脚本中的模型或需要登录 HuggingFace 并接受使用条款的情况，例如SD 3.5 和其他一些型号..也检查一下）

o.en:
This is a very simple ComfyUI beginner friendly Text-to-Image workflow that will work with a single Flux GGUF model with multiple LORAs (This workflow does require ComfyUI's LORA Manager plugin to function. It is a good idea to install both ComfyUI manager and LORA Manager plugin to help you easily download and manage Checkpoints, LORAs and other resources. Not only these two are helpful for this workflow but they will help you a lot in any other cases). I also included all inclusive required model download scripts (for Windows and for Linux/Mac) with this so you can just get started creating your AI Art ASAP as these scripts download all essential core SD 1.5, SDXL 1.0, Flux GGUF and HiDream GGUF files for you. Make sure you install GGUF addon for ComfyUI using ComfyUI manager and place the correct files in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0 and HiDream.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired Flux GGUF model first and then load

#2. one or multiple matching LORA(s) from LORA Manager to start

#3. then input your prompt (The GGUF models for Flux does not accept negative so leave that empty).

#4. select how many images you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#5. select image sampling methods, cfg, steps etc. settings

#6. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

*** This workflow will also function if you know how to properly disable the LORA Node

and bypass it

Enjoy!

( Update - V2.0 with new tweaks now saves output images with timestamp, it's much easier to follow, generates better outputs and I also checked this version with Flux Krea GGUF, besides the old download scripts file I also included inside the new workflow archive file a text file with download links to all new models like WAN 2.2, Flux Krea, HiDream E etc I have been using that were not included on the scripts or require logging into HuggingFace and acceptance of terms of use like in cases of SD 3.5 and some other models.. check that one too )
